job.title: Haul Truck Operators
job.description:
South West Personnel are currently recruiting for the next intake of experienced Haul Truck Operators based at the Bauxite Boddington Mine. These vacancies are an opportunity to be part of a growing operation with future career progression for reliable Operators that easily align with expectations around safety culture and behavioural ethics. Engagement will commence on a casual basis through South West Personnel.

Current vacancies with immediate starts are available for experienced, ticketed and competent Haul Truck Mining Operators in:

  • Rigid Dump Trucks (CAT 777s / CAT 785s or larger)
  • Rigid Dump Truck (Komatsu 785s / 830Es or larger)

To be considered you will:

  • Be experienced safely operating haul trucks in a production mining environment
  • Ensure that pre-start inspections and heavy machinery issues are reported
  • Learn quickly and demonstrate competency through safe work practices and operating procedures
  • Understand the demands of productivity to work safely without compromising on safety guarantee
  • Be fit and healthy – willing to undertake a pre-employment mining medical and random D&A testing
  • Have availability to work a continuous shift roster involving 12-hour shifts – 2 DS 2 NS: 5 OFF – 2 DS 3 NS: 4 OFF – 3 DS 2 NS: 3 OFF
  • Be flexible to attend registration interview in Bunbury and pre-employment medical in Bunbury or Rockingham plus client interview in Boddington, if shortlisted by Client

Only candidates meeting the desired experience level and who reside within or around the greater Boddington region including Dwellingup, Pinjarra or Mandurah will be considered for these vacancies.

Shortlisting will commence immediately! Give yourself a head start by submitting a current CV inclusive of employer name and employment dates along with the names and contact details of two recent work referees.

South West Personnel remains committed to achieving a diverse workforce so we strongly encourage applications from people of diverse backgrounds including Indigenous Australians and females.

~QUICK APPLY NOW~

job.title: Manufacturing Operator
job.description:
South West Personnel are proud to partner with a global leader in the manufacture and maintenance of cable belt conveyor systems. Due to ongoing demand and business growth, our client has immediate opportunities for Manufacturing Operators to join their manufacturing team at the Harvey facility.

If you are seeking a new career opportunity, have an industrial working background and a genuine interest in mechanical and hands-on work, this could be the move you have been waiting for.

Work is undertaken within a clean, organised factory environment with minimal dust and noise. You will be well supported through a comprehensive induction and training program, provided with detailed work instructions and PPE, and become part of a hard-working, friendly and respectful team.

The Role

As a General Manufacturing Operator, your duties will support the quality manufacture of conveyor belts and associated equipment used in critical overland conveyor operations within the mining industry.

Tasks may include

  • Operating rubber extrusion machines to produce conveyor belts
  • Steel rod preparation, including machine cutting, bending and spray-painting
  • Belt press production, final QA checks and repair inspections
  • Grit blasting, painting, polyurethane moulding and hand trimming of steel rims and tyres
  • Final assembly of pulleys supporting conveyor belt systems
  • General industrial labouring including housekeeping, sweeping, high-pressure hosing and cleaning

Essential Attributes

  • A strong work ethic, reliability and attention to detail
  • Commitment to working a 38-hour rostered week
  • A safety-first mindset and understanding of industrial WHS requirements
  • Ability to follow instructions and work effectively within a team
  • Willingness to complete a pre-employment medical and drug & alcohol screen
  • A White Card and prior labouring experience is desirable

Shift Details

Usual roster hours are 5:00am - 2:30pm Monday to Thursday. Hours outside of this attract penalties. Occasionally overtime is offered on a Friday.

These positions are Drive-In Drive-Out (DIDO) and suited to candidates living within a 30-minute commuting distance to Harvey.

If you are a reliable and motivated individual keen to learn the unique process of conveyor belt manufacturing, we encourage you to APPLY NOW.

South West Personnel is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We strongly encourage applications from Indigenous Australians and women.

job.title: Event Labouring Crew - IRONMAN 2026
job.description:
South West Personnel have been engaged by IRONMAN to source a casual Labouring Crew to assist with the set-up and pack-down for the iconic Busselton IRONMAN event prepare for race day on Sunday, 6th December 2026.

Key Dates:
· Set-up Phase: Thursday, 26th November ➡️ Wednesday, 2nd December 2026
· Pack-down Phase: Monday, 7th December ➡️ 9th December 2026

Duties Include:
· Installation and removal of event infrastructure such as marques, bike racks, road blocks, transition area for set-up and recovery
· Erecting and dismantling fencing, blocks, and course barriers
· Swim, bike, and run course preparations to ensure athlete and public safety
· Venue and finish-line construction and pack-down
· General labouring and manual handling duties
· Working alongside event operations teams to meet daily deadlines

Requirements:
· White Card with current drivers licence and reliable transport
· High Risk Forklift (LF, TV, CN, CO, WAH) – Telehandler experience or ticketed with experience will be considered favourably
· Physically fit and capable of manual labour with the ability to complete inductions and follow safety procedures and instructions
· Availability to work all or multiple shifts throughout the event period

Only suitable applicants living in Busselton, Bunbury or the SW region of WA will be considered for shortlisting. Already registered? job.title: Document Controller | Site Administration
job.description:
Only skilled applicants who reside local to the Boddington and surrounding townships or within 1 hours driving distance to the Boddington Mine will be shortlisted for this casual work assignment - up to 6 months work with a view to extension.

The Opportunity:
Working collaboratively with the onsite leadership team and content matter experts the Document Controller will be accountable for providing short-term support in the development, review, and document control of Mine Site Traffic Management Procedures.
Key Responsibilities:

  • Format, update and maintain Traffic Management Procedures and associated documents.
  • Ensure document control standards, version control and approvals are managed effectively.
  • Coordinate reviews with subject matter experts and stakeholders.
  • Track document status and maintain document registers.
  • Support the creation of clear, accurate and professional procedural documentation.

Essential Requirements:

  • Immediate availability and reliably able to commit to the full duration of the work assignment.
  • An excellent skill base and experience in document control, high-level Site administration or technical writing.
  • Previous administrative, document or quality control experience supporting site level operational, mining, construction or safety documentation is desirable.
  • Proven capability to manage multiple documents and stakeholder expectations simultaneously.
  • Strong attention to detail with advanced document formatting skills along with an intermediate level of competency working within Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook and SharePoint).
  • Professional written and verbal skills teamed with a strong organisation and time management awareness.


~~ QUICK APPLY ~~ your CV must be current, including dates of employment and providing names and contact details of at least two recent work referees.

job.title: Meat Process Workers Job Pool
job.description:
Bulk Recruitment Pool:

South West Personnel are currently undertaking a bulk recruitment campaign to support our local clients who are large meat processing facilities supplying quality products to the domestic and international markets.

We are currently seeking reliable and hardworking individuals to join our recruitment pipeline of meat processing team members. These roles are excellent entry level opportunities to build a long-term career or for eligible short term visa workers’ to contribute within a leading meat production facility that values safety, teamwork and product quality.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Processing and preparing meat products to quality standards this will include trimming, cutting, packaging and labelling products ready for despatch
  • Operating processing equipment and machinery
  • Cleanliness and hygiene standards to be maintained to high grade standards
  • Working collaboratively as part of a team to meet production targets

Skills & Experience:

  • Previous experience in the meat industry or food related processing is preferred but not essential
  • Physically fit and capable of manual handling tasks whilst maintaining to work in a fast-paced processing environment
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality output ready for export or supermarket shelves
  • Reliable attendance, able to follow instruction with a positive work ethic

Requirements:

  • Reliable Transport
  • Willing to undertake pre-employment medical, Q-Fever Vaccine and random onsite DAS
  • Full working rights in Australia


To express your interest in being included the meat industry talent pool

job.title: Process Operators - Fixed Plant
job.description:
South West Personnel continues to work with local valued clients who are seeking quality Process Operators to work within their operational facilities. These opportunities provide potential for permanency for best fit casual workers.

Application is now OPEN for quality candidates who have an interest in working as all-rounders within a production environment assisting with fixed plant tasks such as monitoring and controlling crushers, conveyors and processing circuits.

You will be responsible for the day-to-day operation of the plant and must be able to work autonomously as well as part of the crew. Typical tasks associated with routine fixed plant work may include:

  • The safe, efficient extraction, processing or manufacturing of raw materials, often working on rotating shift rosters in mining and manufacturing facilities.
  • Operational tasks of fixed pant to ensure safe production targets are met.
  • Conducting routine inspections, troubleshooting issues and optimising plant performance.
  • Routine housekeeping, clean up and operation al support such as minor maintenance tasks.

Requirements:

  • Priority to workplace safety, following and contributing to safe working practices.
  • Understanding of heavy industrial fixed plant operations.
  • Current WA drivers licence – HR, advantageous.
  • High Risk Forklift licence – LF, highly desirable.
  • Certificate in Process Plant Operations, well regarded.

These roles are subject to a pre-employment medical and drug screen and only shortlisted candidates residing in the SW of WA will be contacted for an interview at the SWP office in Bunbury. SWP embraces diversity and encourages applications from people of all backgrounds.
